pageHeader.title: Programmes Offered
pageHeader.description: Explore our wide spectrum of NMC, DCI, INC, PCI, and UGC approved undergraduate, postgraduate, doctoral, and super-specialty programmes with hands-on hospital exposure.

courses.name: MBBS (Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery)
courses.duration: Four and half year and 1st compulsory rotatory internship
courses.eligibility: A candidate should have passed in the subjects of Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Biotechnology and English individually and having minimum aggregate of 50% in the Intermediate examination of U P Board or 10+2 level equivalent examination from any Board/ University recognized / approved by Bareilly International University. For candidates belonging to SC/ ST/ OBC, aggregate percentage shall be 40% instead of 50% subject to NMC Norms. Minimum age: 17 years as on 31st December of the year of admission.
courses.admissionProcess: Admission is made through counselling based on merit of National eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET). Admission is made only in 1st year and last date for admission is 30th September of the admission year or as notified by NMC or appropriate Authority.
courses.tuitionFee: Check Now. Other charges shall be extra as per university norms.
courses.howToApply: Candidate shall apply for UG- NEET. Notification for applying is made in leading Newspapers and on NEET website during JAN/ FEB once in a year. A candidate has to apply online to participate in NEET. A candidate whose qualifying examination result is awaited can apply for NEET, however he/ she must have result available at the time of counselling. The examinations are held in April / May at various locations and list of qualified students is notified on NEET website. Qualified students have to participate in counselling during July/ Aug. The documents relating to eligibility are verified in the counselling. Candidate allotted seat has to report for admission at college on or before last date mentioned in the allotment letter along with fee and documents.

courses.name: MD (Doctor of Medicine)
courses.eligibility: A candidate who have passed final year of MBBS examination after pursuing a study in a medical college recognized by NMC and completed one year compulsory rotational internship and has obtained permanent registration from State medical council is eligible for admission.
courses.admissionProcess: Admission is made through counselling based on merit of National eligibility cum Entrance Test (PG NEET). Admission is made only in 1st year and last date for admission is 30th May of the admission year or as notified by NMC or appropriate Authority.
courses.tuitionFee: Check Now. Other charges shall be extra as per UP DGME & NMC regulatory notifications.
courses.howToApply: Candidate shall apply for PG-NEET in accordance to notification made on NEET website during Nov/ Dec once in a year. A candidate has to apply online to participate in NEET and will appear in examination online as per program notified on site. A candidate who will complete the rotational Internship before 31st March can apply for NEET counselling. Qualified students have to participate on line state counselling during March / April. Candidate allotted seat shall report for admission at college on or before last date mentioned in the allotment letter along with fee and original documents.

courses.name: MS (Master of Surgery)
courses.eligibility: MBBS degree recognized by NMC with 1-year completed rotatory internship and permanent registration with NMC/State Medical Council.

courses.tuitionFee: Check Now. As prescribed by Government / Fee Regulatory Committee.
